decision: Proceed with one bounded final-operations retry and, only if passed, the complete frozen final matrix. This is not production approval.
reference_rule: Compare this pressure workload to the median contemporaneous qualified-baseline count and zero recompute; all matched candidate counts must be within the observed baseline range and their mean no worse. Zero-preemption workloads retain their zero gate.
rationale: The original hard comparison failed against an archived single count of two. Two of three current qualified-baseline arms recorded three, while all candidate arms recorded two, with identical pool, antecedent workloads, prompt hashes and exact token work. This finite matched evidence does not support a new candidate pressure regression. The failed attempt remains failed; the updated baseline reference is explicit and checksummed.
limitations: Three pairs are a bounded engineering admission check, not a formal stochastic noninferiority proof or a universal maximum preemption count.
No root cause for count variability is established. Arrival/admission history must not be asserted causal without a trace reproducer.
Traced diagnostics are not unbiased throughput evidence.
The current baseline median is three; using a contemporaneous reference changes the archived-single-run comparator, not model capacity, scheduler settings or numerical tolerances.
A failed final retry stops final qualification; do not retry until favorable.
